overview: Before the dress you looked at the new plot on its peg. It names the apparel, the tiring-house door for the vault's mouth, and a trestle for a bier. It has not been walked. No price is written on it.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Read the plot and left it on the peg.

parties.name: Abel Garnish
parties.context: Had hung it, and had not yet timed the morning.

assets.name: Romeo and Juliet
assets.disposition: Saw the plot before the apparel
